# Shared credential for every OCP-dependent catalog item on this account.
# Rotated externally on 2026-06-23 by the console team; nothing here changed.

  secrets:
    - name: ocp4_token
      from: includes/secrets/ocp4_token.yaml

ocp4_pull_secret_name: ocp4_token

# content cannot be inspected from here -- only that every item requires it.

answer:
What is broken: the shared pull-secret credential has gone stale, not the registry.

Three catalog items failed on `east` in the same window -- `llama-stack-demo` (90441), `rhoai-gpu-workshop` (90442) and `windows-containers-lab` (90443) -- all with the same error. Three unrelated items failing identically at once points at something they share rather than at any one of them.

`agd-v2/llama-stack-demo/prod.yaml` shows what that is: every OCP-dependent item on this account requires the credential `ocp4_token`, pulled in from `includes/secrets/ocp4_token.yaml`. The file records that it was rotated externally on 2026-06-23 and that nothing in the config changed -- so the stored copy is now out of date while the configuration that references it is still correct.

The registry itself was fine. The log shows `unable to retrieve auth token: invalid username/password`, which means registry.redhat.io answered and rejected the credentials presented. An unreachable registry fails differently, so this is not a registry outage and not an SSH or bastion problem -- the failing step is a `podman pull`.

Fix: re-encrypt the current pull secret into `includes/secrets/ocp4_token.yaml`. The 3 affected items recover together, because they fail for one shared reason.
